summary: A supplied vector reconstruction of the Fraser Valley Health Region's flower-and-cross emblem (from the September 2000 project report's 78-pixel image) and of a monochrome header with its name and slogan. The package's colour lockup, which joins the colour emblem to the header's lettering, is not an attested arrangement and is not collected. See package-README.md, source/ and review/comparison.webp.

assets.label: Fraser Valley Health Region — Flower and cross
assets.sourceLocator: Project Definition Report, cover (date on PDF page 2)
assets.dateNote: A dated appearance, not an adoption date.
assets.notes: Eight petals, blue and green in turn, around a white cross, from the cover of the Fraser Valley Health Centre / Eastern Fraser Valley Cancer Centre project report of September 2000.
assets.fidelityNote: A supplied reconstruction: one designed petal — a semicircular cap on a right-angled tail — rotated and mirrored into eight, in the report’s blue (#0E218B) and green (#02763F), colour-managed estimates. Silhouette overlap 92.5% with the 78-pixel report image after registration; the source’s slight horizontal distortion is removed.

assets.label: Fraser Valley Health Region — Name and “Integrating Health Care”
assets.sourceLocator: A monochrome printed header, supplied as a screenshot; the document it came from is not recorded. The slogan is also in the region’s Canadian Nurse advertisements of June 1998 and May 2000.
assets.dateNote: A dated appearance, not an adoption date.
assets.notes: The flower, its petals in grey and black, beside FRASER VALLEY HEALTH REGION in bold serif capitals over “Integrating Health Care” in italic: a printed header with the region’s slogan.
assets.fidelityNote: A supplied reconstruction of a monochrome printed header: the petals fitted separately to it (grey #737373 with black outlines), and the lettering from P052 Bold and Bold Italic outlines, a Palatino-style face, with a fine stroke for the print’s weight. The original typeface is not identified.
